mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student (student_id, student_name, birth, gender, school, address, address_detail, app_id, app_password, created_at, center_code, grade_key, status_key, student_privacy_agree) values (#{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{school}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{appId}, #{appPassword}, SYSDATETIME(), #{centerCode}, #{gradeKey}, #{statusKey}, #{studentPrivacyAgree});
mapper.select: SELECT sc.han_user_code, sc.book_user_code, s.*, g.*, reg.registeredClassTypes as classType FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_student_class sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + cc.class_type FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} FOR XML PATH ('') , TYPE ).value('.' , 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') , 1 , 1 , '') AS registeredClassTypes) reg WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND ( reg.registeredClassTypes IS NULL OR reg.registeredClassTypes IN ('1' , '2') ) AND (sc.han_user_code = #{userCode} OR sc.book_user_code = #{userCode} OR sc.han_user_code is null OR sc.book_user_code is null) AND s.status_key = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.school, g.grade_name AS grade, -- l.level_name AS level, s.gender, s.birth, s.address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail, c.center_name AS center, CASE WHEN stuc.entry_han_date IS NOT NULL AND stuc.entry_book_date IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN stuc.entry_han_date <= stuc.entry_book_date THEN stuc.entry_han_date ELSE stuc.entry_book_Date END WHEN stuc.entry_han_date IS NOT NULL THEN stuc.entry_han_date WHEN stuc.entry_book_date IS NOT NULL THEN stuc.entry_book_date ELSE FORMAT(s.created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') END AS entryDate, s.created_at AS createdAt, han.class_name AS hanClass, han.class_key AS hanClassKey, book.class_name AS bookClass, book.class_key AS bookClassKey, stuc.han_fee AS hanFee, stuc.book_fee AS bookFee, stuc.han_material_fee AS hanMaterialFee, stuc.book_material_fee AS bookMaterialFee, stuc.han_user_code AS hanUserCode, stuc.book_user_code AS bookUserCode, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher, CASE WHEN p.parent_tel_first IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_middle IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_last IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.parent_tel_first + '-' + p.parent_tel_middle + '-' + p.parent_tel_last END AS parentTel, s.status_key AS status, sc.status_name AS statusName FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN ERP_GRADE_CODE g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN ERP_STUDENT_CLASS stuc ON s.student_id = stuc.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_CENTER c ON s.center_code = c.center_code LEFT JOIN ERP_PARENT p ON p.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_STATUS_CODE sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key LEFT JOIN ERP_USER hu ON stuc.han_user_code = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN ERP_USER bu ON stuc.book_user_code = bu.user_code
-- APPLY로 class_name 가져오기 OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 cc.class_name, cc.class_key FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND cc.class_type = '1' AND t.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM') ) han
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 cc.class_name, cc.class_key FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND cc.class_type = '2' AND t.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM') ) book
WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId};

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, sc.status_name AS statusName, CASE WHEN stuc.entry_han_date IS NOT NULL AND stuc.entry_book_date IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN stuc.entry_han_date <= stuc.entry_book_date THEN stuc.entry_han_date ELSE stuc.entry_book_Date END WHEN stuc.entry_han_date IS NOT NULL THEN stuc.entry_han_date WHEN stuc.entry_book_date IS NOT NULL THEN stuc.entry_book_date ELSE FORMAT(s.created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') END AS entryDate, g.grade_name AS gradeName, s.school AS school, c.center_name AS centerName,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = t2.class_key WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 1 AND t2.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS hanClass,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = t2.class_key WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 2 AND t2.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS bookClass
FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN ERP_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key LEFT JOIN ERP_grade_code g ON g.grade_key = s.grade_key LEFT JOIN ERP_student_class stuc ON s.student_id = stuc.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_center c ON c.center_code = s.center_code
WHERE 1 = 1 AND s.center_code = #{centerCode}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.user_code = #{userCode} )
ORDER BY s.id
SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.status_key AS statusKey, sc.status_name AS statusName FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN ERP_STATUS_CODE sc on s.status_key = sc.status_key WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE erp_student_class
han_class_key = #{hanClassCode.classKey}, han_user_code = #{hanUser.userCode}, han_fee = #{hanFee}, han_material_fee = #{hanMaterialFee},
book_class_key = #{bookClassCode.classKey}, book_user_code = #{bookUser.userCode}, book_fee = #{bookFee}, book_material_fee = #{bookMaterialFee},
updated_at = SYSDATETIME()
WHERE student_id = #{student.studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_class (student_id, han_class_key, han_user_code, han_status, entry_han_date, han_fee, han_material_fee, book_class_key, book_user_code, book_status, entry_book_date, book_fee, book_material_fee, yy, mm, created_at) VALUES (#{student.studentId}, #{hanClassCode.classKey}, #{hanUser.userCode}, #{hanStatus}, #{entryHanDate}, #{hanFee}, #{hanMaterialFee}, #{bookClassCode.classKey}, #{bookUser.userCode}, #{bookStatus}, #{entryBookDate}, #{bookFee}, #{bookMaterialFee}, #{yy}, #{mm}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, g.grade_name, hc.class_name AS hanClass, bc.class_name AS bookClass, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher, (SELECT MAX(sth.move_at) FROM erp_student_transfer_history sth WHERE sth.student_id = s.student_id) AS moveAt, s.created_at FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_student_class stuc ON s.student_id = stuc.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON stuc.han_class_key = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON stuc.book_class_key = bc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON stuc.han_user_code = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON stuc.book_user_code = bu.user_code WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND stuc.yy = #{yy} AND stuc.mm = #{mm}

choose.when: UPDATE erp_student_class SET han_user_code = #{userCode}, han_fee = 0, han_material_fee = 0, han_class_key = NULL WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
UPDATE erp_student_class SET book_user_code = #{userCode}, book_fee = 0, book_material_fee = 0, book_class_key = NULL WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_transfer_history (student_id, from_user_code, to_user_code, class_type, transfer_reason, class_key, move_at, created_at) VALUES (#{student.studentId}, #{fromUser.userCode}, #{toUser.userCode}, #{classType}, #{transferReason}, #{classCode.classKey}, #{moveAt}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT center_code as centerCode, student_id as stuid, student_name as name, app_token as token FROM erp_student WHERE app_id = #{appId}
SELECT in_time, out_time, attendance_date, student_id, attendance_key FROM erp_student_attendance WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND attendance_date = #{attendanceDate}

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE TO_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE FROM_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.student_id as studentId, s.student_name as studentName, s.app_password as password, c.center_code as centerCode, c.center_name as centerName, s.grade_key as gradeKey, s.app_id as appId, s.app_password as appPassword FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN erp_center c ON s.center_code = c.center_code WHERE s.app_id = #{appId}
